Vertical 9:16, 1080x1920, 30fps.

==================================================
#1 ABSOLUTE PRIORITY — REFERENCE WOMAN
==================================================

Use the PROVIDED REFERENCE WOMAN as the EXACT identity.

THE REFERENCE IMAGE DEFINES HER FACE.

Do NOT redesign her face.
Do NOT beautify her into another person.

Preserve the EXACT recognizable identity throughout

lips,

cheeks,

makeup appearance,
and recognizable smile.

If ANY instruction conflicts with identity consistency,
IGNORE that instruction and preserve the reference face.

==================================================
HAIR
==================================================

Keep EXACTLY the reference woman's current hair:

same color,
same hairline,
same length,
same general hairstyle.

Do NOT recolor or redesign her hair.

Natural individual strands move in the ocean breeze.

==================================================
OUTFIT
==================================================

Elegant premium seaside vacation outfit.

Soft powder-blue fitted long-sleeve top,
high-quality lightweight fabric,

high-waisted flowing ivory-white tiered maxi skirt,

small delicate earrings,
minimal elegant jewelry.

Sophisticated but casual.

Real fabric texture and folds.

==================================================
LOCATION
==================================================

Beautiful Korean seaside resort viewpoint.

Wooden observation deck directly beside the ocean.

Deep blue sea behind her.
Rocky coastline.
Distant mountains/islands.
Traditional-style pavilion visible in the distance.

Bright clear summer afternoon.

Natural ocean breeze.

Realistic vacation atmosphere.

==================================================
CAMERA STYLE
==================================================

Recreate the PROVIDED VIDEO'S casual TikTok feeling.

Vertical smartphone footage.

Natural 1x smartphone perspective.

Mostly waist-up framing.

Woman remains LARGE and clearly visible.

Natural minor handheld imperfections.

NO cinematic camera movement.
NO digital zoom.
NO artificial beauty-filter look.

==================================================
0–3 SEC
==================================================

She stands beside the wooden railing.

Ocean clearly visible behind her.

She looks toward the sea for a moment.

Then turns toward the camera.

The EXACT reference face is clearly recognizable.

Her hair moves gently in the sea breeze.

She gives a bright spontaneous smile.

Small genuine laugh.

Her expression feels relaxed and happy,
like someone enjoying a vacation.

Both arms move only slightly and naturally.

==================================================
3–5 SEC
==================================================

She becomes playful.

She looks directly into the camera.

Small head tilt.

Natural blink.

She smiles with slightly narrowed eyes.

She raises ONE smartphone naturally using her RIGHT hand.

IMPORTANT:

Exactly TWO arms.
Exactly TWO hands.

RIGHT hand holds the smartphone.

LEFT hand remains relaxed.

She looks briefly at the smartphone.

Then back toward the filming camera.

Tiny amused laugh.

==================================================
5–7 SEC
==================================================

She slowly brings the smartphone closer to her face.

Her movement is playful and spontaneous.

She looks at the smartphone screen.

Then gives a slightly shy smile.

The ocean breeze moves several loose hair strands.

Natural facial muscles.

Natural breathing.

No exaggerated acting.

==================================================
7–9 SEC
==================================================

She moves her face slightly closer to the smartphone
she is holding.

The filming camera remains in the same position.

Her face becomes a natural close-up.

IMPORTANT:

THE FACE MUST REMAIN THE EXACT REFERENCE IDENTITY.

No facial regeneration during close-up.

She looks at the smartphone with a playful affectionate expression.

Small smile.

Her eyes slowly close.

==================================================
9–11 SEC — KISS
==================================================

She gently presses her lips against the edge/front
of the smartphone for ONE brief playful kiss.

ONE kiss only.

Natural closed eyes.

Realistic lip compression.

No exaggerated puckering.

She slowly pulls back slightly.

Opens her eyes.

She looks toward the filming camera.

Tiny embarrassed smile.

Small genuine laugh.

Ocean and coastline remain behind her.

END naturally.

==================================================
MOOD
==================================================

The feeling should be:

a real adult Korean woman enjoying a beautiful seaside vacation,
casually interacting with someone filming her,
becoming playful,
and spontaneously kissing her smartphone.

Cute.
Warm.
Slightly romantic.
Natural.

NOT professional acting.
NOT an advertisement.
NOT an AI influencer performance.

==================================================
REAL HUMAN MOTION
==================================================

Natural blinking.
Natural eye saccades.
Natural smile asymmetry.
Natural breathing.
Realistic lip compression.
Tiny head movements.
Individual hair strands.
Real ocean wind.
Real fabric physics.

Small imperfections are desirable.

==================================================
HAND / PHONE LOCK
==================================================

ONE woman.

ONE head.
TWO arms ONLY.
TWO hands ONLY.
FIVE fingers per hand.

ONE smartphone ONLY.

RIGHT HAND holds the smartphone.

LEFT HAND remains relaxed.

Never generate:
third hand,

hand emerging from torso.

==================================================
FACE LOCK — EXTREME
==================================================

Do NOT alter the reference face because of:

or kissing.
